answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 47976 Country: India Title: Question for umrah Question: My nephew is working in Makkah; he can do Umrah for me? Alhamdulillah, I already performed Hajj and Umrah several times. Answer ID: 47976 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1259/1259/M=11/1434) Your bhatija can perform Umrah for you. In-shaAllah, you shall get its reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
